name: Garrick Stonefist

abilities.name: Power Attack
abilities.description: A mighty swing that deals extra damage

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Strike with shield to stun opponent

appearance.distinctive_features: Scar across left eyebrow, braided beard with iron rings

personality.demeanor: Gruff but protective, stands tall with military bearing
personality.speaking_style: Direct and blunt, uses military terminology, speaks in short sentences

beliefs: Honor is earned through action, not words
The strong must protect the weak
A warrior's word is their bond
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Confronts threats head-on with overwhelming force. Prefers to end fights quickly and decisively. Will always issue a warning before attacking unless innocents are in immediate danger. Never strikes an unarmed opponent.

hidden: Father's signet ring (keeps in inner pocket)
Small vial of healing potion (emergency reserve)

secrets: Failed to save his commander during the Battle of Greystone Pass
Believes his younger sister died in a fire five years ago
backstory: A veteran warrior of the King's Guard who left service after failing to protect his commander. Now wanders as a sellsword, taking jobs that protect the innocent while seeking redemption for past failures.
